examples.label: Service status list with coloured status dots
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-indicator" site="Global" color="success" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="flex-1">Public API <.component component_name="chelekom-small" site="Global" size="small" class="text-zinc-500">Operational
<.component component_name="chelekom-indicator" site="Global" color="warning" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="flex-1">Media uploads <.component component_name="chelekom-small" site="Global" size="small" class="text-zinc-500">Degraded
<.component component_name="chelekom-indicator" site="Global" color="danger" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="flex-1">Scheduled publishing <.component component_name="chelekom-small" site="Global" size="small" class="text-zinc-500">Outage

examples.label: Unread dot pinned to the corner of a notification button
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="outline" color="natural" rounded="full" size="small" icon="hero-bell" aria-label="Notifications" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-indicator" site="Global" color="danger" size="medium" class="absolute right-0 top-0 -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/2" />
<.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="outline" color="natural" rounded="full" size="small" icon="hero-envelope" aria-label="Messages" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-indicator" site="Global" color="primary" size="medium" class="absolute right-0 top-0 -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/2" />
